facility.name: Round Rock Kindercare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver was missing annual training on the topics of allergy emergencies and hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: At inspection, three classrooms did not have an evacuation plan, posted.  This was corrected at inspection when the operation posted the missing evacuation plans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have a signed allergy action plan form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The operation did not have a current, fire inspection report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The investigation found that the caregiver left a child unattended, inside a hallway, for approximately five minutes, during operating hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: It was found that the three year old class does not have an activity plan in place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201)

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: The three year old room was observed without any toys available for children to access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2605(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: Children were observed with long down times with nothing to do.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Minimum Standards: It was observed that caregivers know the minimum standards regarding access to toys but are not following them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Minimum Standards (26 TAC §746.1203(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During an investigation inspection there were concerns regarding the potential for mold as well as the walls and ceilings not being clean.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records reviewed 6 children were missing immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation inspection it was found that supervision was not maintained during a transition outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Based on evidence gathered, mold was found to be present in multiple classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found that supervision was not maintained during transition time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unsupervised in the classroom for approximately one minute. This was self reported by the director.    This was corrected at the time of the inspection when all caregivers were observed supervising in compliance with minimum standards. The caregivers were counseled and retrained on supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: This standard was evaluated during the investigation and found out of compliance. A child was left unattended on the playground.     This was corrected at the time of the inspection when all caregivers were observed supervising in compliance with minimum standards. The director stated the caregiver was terminated. The director stated that retraining in supervision would be provided during the next staff meeting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: This standard was evaluated during the investigation and found out of compliance.  A caregiver used an inappropriate tone of voice when talking with children.      This was corrected at the time of inspection when the caregiver was observed disciplining in compliance with minimum standards.  The assistant director stated the caregiver will be re-trained on discipline and classroom management.  The caregiver was also formally counseled regarding appropriate tone of voice and discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A child was left unsupervised on the playground.      This was corrected at the time of the inspection when all caregivers were observed supervising in compliance with minimum standards. The caregivers were counseled and retrained on supervision. Management assists with transitions to and from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Provide Access to Children's Records - During Hours of Operation: A child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have a file available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Access to Children's Records - During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §746.601(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Two children were able to exit all four doors of the operation without any caregivers stopping them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
